raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Customers migrated from the new CRM (2026-01-15) carry numeric region codes '01'-'04' instead of region names. raw_region_map supplies the code-to-name mapping, and silver_customers passes the codes through unmapped, which causes the DOMAIN_CHECK alert and would misassign those customers in gold_region_daily.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, COALESCE(upper(m.region_name), upper(c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON c.region = m.region_code;"}}
